description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the VisitValidator class in the OpenMRS project. It tests validation logic related to patient visits, such as date overlaps, required fields, and data consistency.

classes.name: VisitValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the VisitValidator validation logic in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Sets up test data and environment before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets global properties after each test.

methods.name: validate_shouldAcceptAVisitThatHasTheRightNumberOfAttributeOccurrences
methods.description: Tests that a valid visit with correct attribute occurrences passes validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectAVisitIfItHasFewerThanMinOccursOfAnAttribute
methods.description: Tests validation failure when a visit has fewer attribute occurrences than the minimum required.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectAVisitIfItHasMoreThanMaxOccursOfAnAttribute
methods.description: Tests validation failure when a visit has more attribute occurrences than allowed.

methods.name: makeVisit
methods.description: Utility method to create a new Visit instance with an assigned patient.

methods.name: makeVisit
methods.description: Overloaded method to create a Visit for a specific patient ID.

methods.name: makeAttribute
methods.description: Creates a VisitAttribute with a specified value.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfPatientIsNotSet
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the patient is not assigned to the visit.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfStartDatetimeIsNotSet
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the start date/time of the visit is not set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfVisitTypeIsNotSet
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the visit type is not set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheEndDatetimeIsBeforeTheStartDatetime
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the stop date/time is before the start date/time.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheStartDatetimeIsAfterAnyEncounter
methods.description: Tests failure when visit start date is after an existing encounter's date.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheStopDatetimeIsBeforeAnyEncounter
methods.description: Tests failure when visit stop date is before an existing encounter's date.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAnAttributeIsBad
methods.description: Disabled test for invalid attribute values during visit validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectAVisitThatStartsBeforeAndEndsAfterAnExistingVisit
methods.description: Tests rejection of a visit overlapping an existing one with start before and end after.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectAVisitThatStartsBeforeAndEndsDuringAnExistingVisit
methods.description: Tests rejection when a visit starts before and ends during an existing visit.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectAVisitThatStartsDuringAndEndsAfterAnExistingVisit
methods.description: Tests rejection when a visit starts during and ends after an existing visit.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectAVisitThatStartsAndEndsDuringAnExistingVisit
methods.description: Tests rejection when a visit is fully within another visit's timeframe.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectAVisitThatStartsAtTheSameTimeAsAnExistingVisit
methods.description: Tests rejection when a visit starts exactly at the same time as an existing one.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectAVisitThatEndsAtTheSameTimeAsAnExistingEvent
methods.description: Tests rejection when a visit ends exactly at the same time as an existing visit.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectOverlappingNewActiveVisit
methods.description: Tests rejection of a new active visit overlapping an existing one.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectOverlappingActiveVisits
methods.description: Tests rejection of overlapping ongoing (active) visits.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotRejectOnVisitOverlapDuringEndVisit
methods.description: Ensures validation does not reject valid end visit overlaps.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectOnVisitOverlapDuringEndVisitWithStartDateUpdated
methods.description: Tests rejection of overlapping visits during an end visit call with a start date update.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotRejectOnVisitOverlapDuringUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that an update without conflict does not cause validation failure.

methods.name: patientHasVoidedVisit
methods.description: Checks if the patient has a specific voided visit overlapping with given times.

methods.name: validate_shouldAcceptAVisitIfStartDateTimeIsEqualToStartDateTimeOfAnotherVoidedVisitOfTheSamePatient
methods.description: Tests acceptance when the start date matches another voided visit of the same patient.

methods.name: validate_shouldAcceptAVisitIfStartDateTimeFallsIntoAnotherVoidedVisitOfTheSamePatient
methods.description: Tests acceptance when start datetime falls into a voided visit's period.

methods.name: validate_shouldAcceptAVisitIfStopDateTimeFallsIntoAnotherVoidedVisitOfTheSamePatient
methods.description: Tests acceptance when stop datetime falls into a voided visit's period.

methods.name: validate_shouldAcceptAVisitIfItContainsAnotherVoidedVisitOfTheSamePatient
methods.description: Tests acceptance when the visit period contains another voided visit.

methods.name: parseIsoDate
methods.description: Utility method to parse ISO date strings into Date objects.
